newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: PacBBA appoints new plastics chief.
newsitem.headline: PacBBA appoints new plastics chief.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Pacific BBA Ltd said on Monday Trevor White had been appointed as managing director of the company's plastics division.
White, who was previously general manager of two Comalco Ltd divisions, would replace Barry Vaughan who retires in mid-1997, Pacific BBA said in a statement.
Pacific BBA managing director Barry Jackson said White was ideally equipped to handle the challenges that lay ahead for the division.
"Our plastics division is expanding rapidly in the Asia-Pacific region. We already have plants in five countries and have plans for further growth," he added.
Vaughan would remain a director of several Pacific BBA joint-venture businesses in Asia.
